title: Chris Paul Super Fan Lil Wayne Has Strong Message For Mavs' Luka Doncic
htmlContent:
The Dallas Mavericks have been leading the Phoenix Suns throughout the whole time in game 4. Luka Doncic and Jalen Brunson have been able to help Chris Paul and has fouled out at the time that this article is written.

It has also caught the attention of a Chris Paul support in Lil Wayne who at home watching the game on television.

Let's just say he's not a fan of Doncic after he tweeted that, he's a h*.

"Luka a h*"

Doncic leads the Mavs with 24 points, seven rebounds, and eight assists, while Brunson has11 points, four rebounds, and two assists. The Mavs lead 97-83 with 6:02 left in the fourth quarter.

According to Skip Bayless, Paul and Lil Wayne have a genuine love for each other.

"My friend Lil Wayne was courtside to support his friend Chris Paul for every game at Staples. They just hugged. Genuine love."

Back when Lil Wayne was hospitalized in 2013, according to TMZ, Paul checked in on the Carter six rapper.

"Lil Wayne had no shortage of famous visitors last night Clippers, now Suns guard Chris Paul and his wife Jada stopped by Cedars-Sinai to see how the famous rapper was doing. 

Cameras also caught Drake, Weezy's protégé, visiting Wayne last night as well. As TMZ first reported, Wayne was hospitalized twice this week for seizures. His situation was dire last night, but his condition eventually stabilized."

He also paid Wayne a visit when he was on Rikers Island, according to ESPN.

The first thing Wayne did once he was released was go see Paul at a Pelicans game, according to Rolling Stone Magazine.
